title: Daylight's End
why: Among the quietest tracks measured (-19 dB RMS) with wide swells (11 dB range); dark, slow cinematic login theme for a moody cold open

title: Thornmail
why: One of the flattest of the 70 measured tracks (1 dB range), steady ~89 bpm pulse; sits under narration without pulling focus

title: Sett, the Boss
why: Also very even (2.4 dB range) at ~99 bpm but a punchier brass/hip-hop colour, so the categories section sounds different from the data bed

title: The Hex Core
why: Builds +4.5 dB from first to last third with 10.5 dB range; tense electronic rise for the twists (trimmed to 4:00 with fade)

title: Tales Of The Rift
why: Biggest build of the Riot set (+9.7 dB from start to end); full orchestral swell for the emotional reveal
